summary: Add signed APT repository publish tooling, nginx /apt/ snippets and unit tests for the private website host. API impact: none; no Controller/Core contracts.

guide.reason: Private website-host APT packaging notes live in packaging/apt/README.md; Controller/Core operator workflows are unchanged.

api.reason: Static APT repository files and publish scripts do not call or change Nex Controller operations, Core commands, observed-state results or client-facing service APIs.

verification.method: python3 -m unittest tests.test_apt_publish -v against disposable tempfile repos; dpkg-deb/dpkg-scanpackages and gpg exercised locally.
